name: Bracket post
summary: An 8-spot bracket in a feed post where friends vote the semis and final and crown a champ.
useWhen: a post asking for the best of something with many contenders
'best late night food in SF', 'best boba near campus, bracket style'
dontUseWhen: a simple pick among 2-4 options (use a poll)

title.description: e.g. 'Best late night food in SF'

left.description: Time left in the round, e.g. '3h left'

teams.description: 8 entries in bracket order: name, plus food (burrito, taco, donut, shake, pizza, burger, curry, fries) only when every entry is a food; leave food out for anything else (teams, bands, places) and they get initials

kind.description: food draws food icons; initials (default unless every entry names a food) draws a coloured disc with initials

quarters.description: Round 1 winners: for each of the 4 pairs, 0 (first) or 1 (second)

semis.description: Votes from outside this chat for each semi: [[first, second], [first, second]]

final.description: Outside votes for the final, [first, second]

people.description: Chat members' semi votes by team name
